Mantener IFR

A phrase used to instruct the pilot to continue flying under Instrument Flight Rules.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Mantener IFR?

In this glossary, Mantener IFR refers to: A phrase used to instruct the pilot to continue flying under Instrument Flight Rules.

How is Mantener IFR used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "ATC instruye: 'Mantenga condiciones IFR, informe cualquier desviación del plan de vuelo.'"

Why does Mantener IFR matter in aviation?

Mantener IFR matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Mantener IFR?

Mantener IFR is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Mantener IFR belong to?

In this glossary, Mantener IFR is grouped under Basic ATC. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A phrase used to instruct the pilot to continue flying under Instrument Flight Rules.

Operational example

ATC instructs: 'Maintain IFR conditions, report any deviations from flight plan.'

Localized term

Mantener IFR

Localized example

ATC instruye: 'Mantenga condiciones IFR, informe cualquier desviación del plan de vuelo.'
